name: aio-sandbox-static-assets
description: Upstream npm bundles served by nginx at /static/sandbox. Pinned to exact versions and fetched at build time (Dockerfile 'static-assets' stage) instead of being vendored into git. Modernized fork: swagger-ui-dist bumped past the original image; the others remain byte-identical to it (verified by hash). NOTE: favicon.png is not an npm package and stays in rootfs.
